mechanism: Both drugs are metabolized by hepatic CYP450 enzymes (primarily CYP3A4) and may compete for metabolism, potentially increasing levels of one or both agents; additionally, both can cause CNS effects and may have additive neurotoxicity.
action: Monitor for increased adverse effects including dizziness, headache, and GI disturbances; consider dosing adjustments or spacing administration if hepatic impairment is present; use together only when benefits outweigh risks in parasitic co-infections.
